+    manager: InterruptManager,
+    request: NavigationTakeoverRequest,
+) -> str | None:
+    """Return one exact takeover-enabled navigation checkpoint for the live page."""
+    if not request.page_signature:

+    if thread_id is None:

+    matches: list[str] = []
+    for record in manager.get_pending_interrupts(str(request.run_id)):
+        context = record.navigation_context()
+        if context is None or not context.checkpoint:
+            continue
+        if (
+            context.run_id == str(request.run_id)
+            and context.thread_id == thread_id
+            and context.generation == int(request.generation)
+            and context.page_signature == request.page_signature
+            and context.takeover_available
+        ):
